game.tooltip.copy_displayed_result_a0a67: Copy the result currently shown, using the selected response format.
game.tooltip.describe_the_current_game_s: Describe what is happening in the game. This text is sent to Mammoth as the context for its decision.
game.tooltip.question_00a700: Ask a yes-or-no question. Mammoth returns its probability for yes.
game.tooltip.question_and_choices_731faf: Enter the question on the first line, then at least two choices or score levels on separate lines. Numbered entries are allowed. Choice supports up to 255 options; Score supports up to 10 levels.
game.tooltip.question_type_e19501: Choose the kind of answer Mammoth should return: select one choice, score among levels, or estimate the chance of yes.
game.tooltip.response_55a982: Choose what to display after the decision. Structured shows the full response and metrics; Compact shows only the answers. This does not change the decision.
game.tooltip.run_decision_f75818: Send the game state and question to Mammoth and show its answer. The service must be running with the model loaded.
game.tooltip.start_load_mammoth_f9c729: Start the managed Mammoth service and load its model so it can answer decisions.
game.tooltip.stop_managed_mammoth_31e262: Stop the Mammoth service managed by this studio.
